items.title: How Banco BMG moved from reactive to autonomous operations with AWS DevOps Agent
items.summary: Summary Banco BMG is a Brazilian financial institution with 96 years of history. Its digital platform runs across AWS, other cloud providers, and on-premises infrastructure. At that scale, logs, metrics, alerts, and deployments come in faster than engineers can correlate them. When an incident hits a revenue-generating product such as PIX instant payments or payroll […]
